to fall; to drop down, descend
to fall down, tumble down
entries.notes: M 栏第二音节注 T99 污损，依 H 与西语 caer 定义。

entries.zh: 跌；摔倒（西语释义为跌落、向下坠）
entries.en: to fall; to tumble, slip and fall
entries.notes: 西语词头拼写作 baqsear 等误写，语义按 caer 系列定；H 跌 与 M guă 互证。

entries.en: to fall (and strike the ground)
entries.notes: H 跌着 着 作接触/着地解；R 栏多出 pōant 一音，或为同义补充词。

entries.en: to fall over, fall down (of a person)

entries.zh: 跌落馬下；从马上摔下来
entries.en: to fall off the horse, be thrown from horseback
entries.notes: M 栏末尾标 [残]，据西语 caer del caballo 与 R 栏补全。

entries.en: to peck (as a bird); to fall upon pecking
entries.notes: 西语词头文字杂乱（含 ut supra el papa 抄误），以 H 啄 与 M tôy 为准。

entries.zh: 啄成空；啄穿成孔、啄出洞
entries.en: to peck a hole in something, pecking till it wounds or hollows it
entries.notes: 西语 caer sobre algo y hacer herida（落在他物上致伤）；H 啄成空 之 空 或为孔义，T99 污损一处。

entries.en: to fall, fall down; topple over
to fall down, collapse and drop
to turn over, topple over; to fall by overturning
entries.notes: M 栏 huān 后另有多余音节 cos 语义不明，T99 污损，以 翻 为准。

entries.en: (of a leaf) to drop off, fall from the tree; to shed
entries.notes: 西语释义为树叶落下（anblaya enclaya 疑为附加音译词）；H 甩 此处取脱落义。

entries.en: (of a leaf) to fall into the water
(of leaves) to fall, drop; to shed
entries.notes: 零 单字在此语境取（叶）落下义，非数字零。

entries.en: (of leaves) to fall scattered, shed and drop
entries.notes: M 栏附 Lao ta caunc 一串音写 T99 污损、语义不明（或为干枯义补充），只以 零落 定义。
